Title: Azure Cosmos DB Python SDK Version 4 is now in preview

Body.Content:
Version 4 of the Azure Cosmos DB Python SDK is now available and includes usability updates to the object model for a better developer experience as well as the ability to use partition keys to scale non-partitioned containers. The SDK is fully open-sourced and part of the Azure SDK for Python repo. 

Learn more and get started.  Log issues and feedback in the GitHub repo.

Log issues and feedback in the GitHub repo
